expert.title: Cycles and memory resources usage
expert.txt:
Assuming all data fit into the L1 cache, each call to the function takes 39.40 cycles. At this rate:
 - 3% of peak load performance is reached (3.86 out of 128.00 bytes loaded per cycle (GB/s @ 1GHz))
 - 5% of peak store performance is reached (3.25 out of 64.00 bytes stored per cycle (GB/s @ 1GHz))

expert.title: Front-end bottlenecks
expert.txt:
Performance is limited by instruction throughput (loading/decoding program instructions to execution core) (front-end is a bottleneck).

By removing all these bottlenecks, you can lower the cost of an iteration from 39.40 to 29.00 cycles (1.36x speedup).
